info.title: ASPA Explorer API
info.description: ASPA objects validated by Routinator at rpki.ping6.it, their history and quality, for any AS. Open data, read-only, no key.

get.summary: The ASPA, history and quality of one AS

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: AS number, without the AS prefix (32-bit)

200.description: The AS. An AS with no ASPA, now or ever, has aspa.published false and empty lists.

get.summary: A badge with the number of providers in the ASPA of the AS
Atom feed of the latest 100 changes that concern the AS
When the per-AS files were built
All valid ASPAs (Routinator jsonext, route origins and router keys left out)

post.summary: Subscribe an e-mail address or a webhook to the changes of one AS
post.description: E-mail: a confirmation message is sent and the subscription starts when its link is confirmed (the answer is the same whether or not the address was already subscribed). Webhook: the address is called with a verification challenge it must repeat; on success the answer carries the signing secret, once.

target.description: An e-mail address, or an https address with a public host name

400.description: Invalid input or failed webhook verification

429.description: Too many requests: from your address (an IPv6 address counts with its /64), for the AS, or confirmation messages to this address from your network today (at most three)

post.summary: Confirm an e-mail subscription with the token of the link

404.description: The link is not valid any more

post.summary: Cancel a subscription (also the target of List-Unsubscribe and of the unsubscribe field of a webhook)

403.description: A request from the page of another site

get.summary: Adoption of ASPA by RIR, country and size of the network
get.description: Built once a day from the validator, the RIPE RIS collectors, the RIR delegation files and the CAIDA AS Relationships dataset.

get.summary: The whole list of ASPAs, one object per ASPA
The whole list of ASPAs as CSV (providers separated by spaces in one cell)
The places of valley of today in the routes of the collectors
get.description: Built once a day from the 00:00 UTC table dumps of 33 collectors of RIPE RIS and RouteViews (scripts/build-leaks.mjs): every route is checked with the downstream ASPA verification and the paths that the ASPAs prove to contain a valley are grouped by the place of the valley.

only.description: places that only this collector sees

families.description: the same totals for IPv4 and IPv6

gaps.description: ASPAs that seem to miss a provider

get.summary: The daily totals of the places of valley
get.description: One row a day since 1 September 2026, written by the valley job.

get.summary: The places of valley that involve each AS
get.description: Places seen by at least min_feeders feeders, by AS, for the page of an AS and for the notifier.

as.description: AS number (ASnnn) -> array of places {role, kind, from, to, between, feeders, routes}

get.summary: The ASPAs of four validators compared
get.description: Every hour: the two validators of this site, Routinator and Fort, rpki-client (the console of the project) and the rpki-client of Cloudflare (scripts/build-validators.mjs).

providers.description: validator id -> providers, or null when it does not have the ASPA

get.summary: The ASPAs of the Fort of this site
get.description: Fort's own output (output.aspa), as it writes it, copied every hour by scripts/build-validators.mjs: Fort has no web interface of its own.

200.description: The file: an object keyed by customer AS number, each with the list of its provider AS numbers

get.summary: The RTR session with the validator, as independent RTR clients see it
get.description: Every five minutes (scripts/build-rtr.mjs) from the telemetry of RAVEN's rtr monitor, one monitor for each cache: the validator of the site (the top-level fields) and every cache followed, references included (caches). The anomalies are those of the adaptive detector of the monitor on the stream of syncs.

protocol.description: RTR version agreed, 2 carries the ASPAs

serial_stale.description: the cache answers but its serial has not changed for stale_after_s; a full resync counts as a change, since it delivers everything the cache holds

points.description: [time (s), vrp_total, aspa_total, vrp_changes, aspa_changes], one an hour for 30 days

probes.description: anomalies that a monitor up to RAVEN 0.4.0 wrote for a version probe refused by the cache, left out; later monitors write none

next_protocol.description: on a version probe refused, the version the monitor goes on with

metrics.description: the gauges of the monitor, when its Prometheus endpoint answers

http.description: the count of ASPAs of the JSON export of the first cache, to compare

items.description: one entry for each cache followed, with id, name, host, note and the same fields as the top level

get.summary: Networks with an ASPA month by month
get.description: Built once a day (scripts/build-trends.mjs): for all of them and for each RIR and country.

rir.description: rir -> array of integers, one for each month

get.summary: What the ASPAs say about the routing incidents of the detectors
get.description: Built once a day (scripts/build-incidents.mjs) from the incidents that the detectors of the project find in the RIS Live stream.

adoption.description: the curve of the verdicts as more networks publish an ASPA

get.summary: The invalid announcements of the last 14 days, as the collectors receive them
get.description: RIS Live, about nine minutes in every ten (scripts/watch-invalid.mjs): by hour, by origin AS and by prefix.

get.summary: AS numbers from allocation to ASPA
get.description: Built once a day (scripts/build-resources.mjs) from the RIR delegation files, the collectors, the validator and the World Bank: by RIR, region, economy, year of allocation and width of the number.

get.summary: The checks of the status page, every 15 minutes, for 90 days
get.description: scripts/build-status.mjs: a sample is [seconds since the epoch, one letter for each check: o OK, l late, d down, - not checked], in the order of checks.

get.summary: The availability of each part of the service by month
get.description: The tallies of the samples of the status history, kept for good.

get.summary: The providers that the CAIDA relationships infer for each AS
get.description: Built once a day with the adoption numbers.

providers.description: AS number (digits) -> array of provider AS numbers

get.summary: The registry and the country of each AS number
get.description: From the delegation files of the five RIRs, once a day.

get.summary: The daily history of the ASPAs since 12 October 2023
get.description: A copy of the history branch, refreshed every ten minutes: one row a day.

items.description: with aspas_<rir> for each RIR and the coverage figures

get.summary: Every change of an ASPA since 12 October 2023
get.description: A copy of the history branch: [date, customer, providers or null when the ASPA was removed].

get.summary: The ASes with an ASPA that the collectors do not see
get.description: A copy of the history branch, written by the daily snapshot.

get.summary: The dated snapshots for research
get.description: One .tar.gz a month with the files of the API, a manifest of SHA-256 sums and a README; CC BY 4.0.

get.summary: The raw telemetry of one RTR monitor
get.description: The NDJSON that RAVEN's rtr monitor writes for the cache: one record a line for each session event (connected, disconnected, reset, error, cache_not_ready, version_downgrade), each sync (with vrp_total, aspa_total, the records announced and withdrawn, sync_type and the duration) and each anomaly of its detector (category, trigger, severity, z_scores, raw). Since the monitor started; a few hundred lines a day.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: the id of the cache, as in the caches of rtr.json

get.summary: The baseline of the anomaly detector of one RTR monitor
get.description: The snapshot that RAVEN's rtr monitor saves every few minutes: the windows of the six measures (interval since the previous sync, duration, VRPs and ASPAs announced and withdrawn) that the detector compares each sync with.

404.description: No such cache, or no baseline saved yet

get.summary: The Prometheus metrics of one RTR monitor
get.description: The raven_rtr_* gauges and counters of the monitor (session state, VRP and ASPA counts, last sync, last serial change, data expired, protocol version, anomalies by severity), in the Prometheus text format.

get.summary: The invalid announcements of one day
get.description: The daily file of watch-invalid.mjs for one of the last fourteen days: the runs of the day with their counts, and the origins and prefixes with most invalid announcements.

404.description: Not one of the last fourteen days

get.summary: Every incident of the detectors, one record a line
get.description: The file that the aggregates of incidents.json come from, written once a day: for each incident its type and subtype, actor, start and end (UTC), why it ended, the number of AS paths kept, and the verdicts of the downstream ASPA verification with the ASPAs of the day (real) and with complete ASPAs (complete). Tens of megabytes.

schema.description: one JSON object a line: {type, subtype, actor, start, end, end_reason, paths, real, complete}

get.summary: The verdict of the ASPAs on an AS path (the procedure of draft-ietf-sidrops-aspa-verification)

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The AS path as routers print it: the neighbour first, the origin last, AS numbers separated by spaces or commas; 64 ASes at most

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: upstream (the route comes from a customer or a peer) or downstream (it comes from a provider)

200.description: The verdict and what it comes from

as_path.description: The path as given, without prepending

hops.description: From the origin to the neighbour

400.description: The path or the direction cannot be read

503.description: The ASPAs have not been read yet

get.summary: Every finding of the quality checks on the ASPAs

200.description: The kinds of finding and the findings

get.summary: The state of the validator (Routinator's /api/v1/status)
Where the instances of the DNS root servers are, for the check of the place of RIPE Atlas probes
Origin validation of one route by Routinator (ROAs, not ASPAs)

404.description: Not an AS number and a prefix

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 prefix, for example 193.0.0.0/21

post.summary: Freeze a result into a link, kept for 30 days
post.description: Plain text only, 200 KB at most; 20 reports an hour and 100 a day from one address.

source.description: The address on the site that runs the same check again

429.description: Too many reports from this address

get.summary: A shared result

200.description: The report as it was stored

source.description: The address on the site that runs the same check again

404.description: It does not exist or has expired

get.summary: Atom feed of the changes to all ASPAs
The invalid announcements of the last ten-minute run of the watcher, by origin AS
get.description: Only the origins with at least `min` invalid announcements; the notifier reads it for the alerts.

collected.description: How the run listened to RIS Live: whether it could, for how long, messages and announcements received

get.summary: The places of valley that involve each AS, on one of the last 60 days
get.description: Places seen by at least min_feeders feeders, by AS, for the page of an AS and for the notifier.

as.description: AS number (ASnnn) -> array of places {role, kind, from, to, between, feeders, routes}

get.summary: Whether the service that sends the notifications is working

provider_of.description: ASes whose ASPA names this AS as a provider

NotBuilt.description: The file is not there yet: the job that writes it has not run on this host

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests from this address: try again later
